name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Adopt the **Claude Self-Improvement Skill Pack** to automate prompt tuning and routing. It’s the fastest way to cut manual review cycles while keeping quality high—trade-off is dependency on external skills, but the pack is open-source and designed for this exact use case.

name: Gauge
text: The Skill Pack’s "automated prompt tuning" is a black box—we’d trade drift risk for speed. A 5% canary still exposes 1 in 20 users to a broken prompt—enough to damage trust. Instead, audit the prompts first, then automate only the safe, rule-based tweaks. Settle it by running a 1% canary for a week with manual fallback.
